title: How Do I Fix: The EnableHyperlinks property has not been set for this report.
summary: When RDLC report layouts contain hyperlinks, the EnableHyperlinks property must be set in the AL report definition. This property cannot be set in Report Extension objects, creating a problem for extended standard reports. A workaround is to place URLs directly in textbox values instead of using the Action, Go to URL feature.
key_points: The EnableHyperlinks property is required for RDLC layouts with hyperlinks and must be set on the main report object, not in Report Extension objects
Version 27 upgrade triggered this error for some standard reports that previously worked without the property set
Workaround: use textbox values for URLs instead of the Action, Go to URL feature in RDLC layouts to enable clickable links without the property
Custom RDLC layouts created via Report Extension objects can implement this workaround through the Report Layouts page

quotes.text: The EnableHyperlinks property needs to be set in the AL part of the report if you want to use HyperLinks in the RDLC layout.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the technical requirement that EnableHyperlinks must be set on the report itself, not in extensions

quotes.text: This property can not be set in a Report Extension object.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core constraint that forces users to find workarounds when extending standard reports
